Introduction

Fye also known as Faii and Fyeqoodgurl is a Thai singer-songwriter, producer and actress under D.U.M.B. Recordings. She is a former member of the girl group BNK48 and its Team BIII. She made her solo debut on June 10, 2022 with the digital single "Gone Gurl".

In 2023, she participated in a Mnet survival show called "Queendom Puzzle", where she was eliminated after ranking 16th.
